rf: Observed Gaborium responses, standardized stimulus; no RF smoothing. Each map shown at its own discrete spatial-variance peak.
saccade: Observed BackImage spike counts aligned to detected saccade START, nearest 240-Hz bin. Overlapping detections merged; no amplitude or inter-saccade-interval cutoff. Complete -100 to +300 ms windows inside one continuous trial with all DPI samples valid. Same events in every bin and for every unit in a session. Nonoverlapping 16.67-ms bins; no smoothing or baseline subtraction. Descriptive average of all available trials, not a held-out score.
